title: Structurally Close, Temporally Distant: Measuring Security Exposure in Long-Horizon LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.05911v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents interact with untrusted content, persistent memory, external state, and sensitive tools. Existing analyses often characterize attacks by the number of execution steps between malicious input and a downstream action. We show that temporal remoteness can overstate security separation in stateful agents. We introduce a provenance-aware execution graph linking agent events through deterministic state, identifier, and tool provenance, and define \emph{influence distance} $\DI$ as the shortest structural path from an untrusted source to a sensitive action. We compare it with \emph{sequence distance} $\DT$, the shortest injection--sink path in the ordered trajectory. Since the influence graph contains every sequence edge, $\DI \leq \DT$; $\Gap=\DT-\DI$ measures the separation hidden by step count. translated_title: 结构上相近，时间上遥远：测量长时程LLM智能体的安全暴露
translated_abstract: 长时程LLM智能体需要与不可信内容、持久记忆、外部状态以及敏感工具进行交互。现有分析通常通过恶意输入与下游动作之间的执行步骤数来刻画攻击。我们证明了在有状态的智能体中，时间上的遥远程度可能会夸大安全隔离的效果。我们引入了一种溯源感知的执行图，通过确定性的状态、标识符和工具溯源将智能体事件关联起来，并将影响距离 $\DI$ 定义为从不可信源到敏感动作的最短结构路径。我们将其与序列距离 $\DT$ 进行比较，后者是有序轨迹中从注入点到敏感汇聚点的最短路径。由于影响图包含所有序列边，因此 $\DI \leq \DT$；而 $\Gap=\DT-\DI$ 度量的是被步骤数所掩盖的隔离程度。在基于OpenAI的gpt-4o-mini等模型的360条长时程AgentDojo轨迹中的454个注入-汇聚对上（摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种溯源感知的执行图与“影响距离”新度量，证明在有状态的长时程LLM智能体中，仅凭时间步骤数衡量攻击距离会高估安全隔离，并通过“间隔”量化被步骤数掩盖的真实安全暴露。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a provenance-aware execution graph with a new "influence distance" metric, showing that temporal step counts overstate security separation in stateful long-horizon LLM agents, and defines a gap measure to quantify the security exposure hidden by step counts.
